acceptanceCriteria: All managed entities and immutable snapshots are represented with stable IDs, constraints, indexes, explicit ordering, and transactional writes.
Android, iOS, and test SQLDelight drivers plus Settings and private file adapters have explicit lifecycle and do not leak generated row types.
Core setup/catalog/recipe/batch/observation/plan/terminal contracts have real database integration tests and preserve immutable snapshots.
Backup preview/replace is validate-first and atomic across database and staged photos; invalid, cancelled, corrupt, unsupported, repeat, and insufficient-storage cases preserve existing state.
CSV is UTF-8, escaped, documented, excludes photos, and is not restorable; delete-all clears all local product state.
No external secrets, translated built-in text, Firebase/Yandex SDK logic, UI, Stores, or platform picker/notification APIs are added.
goal: Implement the complete offline local-data foundation in a new shared:data KMP module, including SQLDelight schema/queries/migrations/drivers, typed Settings, private photo storage contracts/adapters, domain manager implementations, immutable snapshots, transactional staged backup/restore, CSV export, complete erasure, and deterministic tests. This assignment establishes database-integration surfaces for the listed core contracts while also implementing the approved downstream local-data capabilities; later assignments will register remaining AC-specific evidence. Store only stable localization keys for built-in catalog data. Do not edit settings.gradle.kts or the version catalog; the orchestrator will wire the module/tool aliases separately.
